title: Phase1 parity closure batch: VRF, Load Balancing, High Availability, Traffic Policy, PKI, Configuration Index
acceptance_criteria: Backend exposes scoped read/batch endpoints for vrf, load-balancing, high-availability, traffic-policy, and pki using thin wrappers around existing VyOS service integration.
Frontend provides form-driven pages for each of the above domains with no free-form CLI text entry.
Sidebar navigation links to new pages and route loading remains stable.
Backend tests, TypeScript check, frontend build, runtime smoke, and UI smoke all pass.
Coverage artifacts regenerate with full Phase1 implementation and no remaining partial/not_started domains.
assumptions: Initial forms prioritize high-frequency workflows and can be expanded with deeper knobs in follow-up slices.
Unrelated pre-existing dirty files in the worktree are preserved untouched.
Command semantics for advanced options will continue to be validated against live VyOS targets in later cycles.

tasks.notes: Added scoped wrappers and router registration for all remaining non-routing parity domains.
Replaced placeholders with form-first pages and added configuration index navigation.
Added backend wrapper tests and expanded smoke route coverage for new pages.
Updated coverage aliasing/token handling and regenerated parity artifacts to full Phase1 implementation.
Manual review completed for API contract consistency and command-scope safety.
